newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-PORTUGAL'S RUI COSTA TO STAY AT FIORENTINA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTUGAL'S RUI COSTA TO STAY AT FIORENTINA.

text.p: Portugal midfielder Rui Costa said on Friday he had signed to stay at Italian first division club Fiorentina until the year 2001.

"I like it here and there was no reason to change clubs, because even if a lot of teams wanted me, no one wanted me as much as Fiorentina did," Costa told reporters after signing a new contract, said by Italian media to be worth two billion lire ($1.3 million) a season.
"I trust this team's management and I am confident I can win everything I want here," said Costa.

His old contract had been due to expire in June 1998 and Costa had been tipped to leave Florence, partly because of his relationship with coach Claudio Ranieri, who has substituted him 35 times in 91 games.
"Now I can substitute Rui Costa without any problems," Ranieri quipped after Costa signed the contract.
